::: {.callout-note}
OrgPath's 15-facet organizational model was built on top of Microsoft Entra ID's extensionAttribute schema — the right starting point for federal agencies, but not the ending point. This book introduces binding profiles: the abstraction that decouples what a facet means from where it lives on a given platform. When binding profiles are in place, the same codebook governs identity and workload across AWS, GCP, VMware, Okta, PingOne, Keycloak, Auth0, and generic LDAP — nine substrates, one governance model.
:::
